Geometry in three dimensions, rays, planes and conics

Source: R/geometry-extra.R
geometry-3d.Rd

Point3D(), Line3D(), Segment3D(), Ray() (Ray2D(), Ray3D()), Plane(), Ellipse(), Parabola() and Curve() extend the plane geometry of Point(). distance(), intersection(), is_parallel(), area() and contains() accept them. The accessors follow SymPy's properties: direction_ratio(), direction_cosine(), arbitrary_point(), equation(), normal_vector(), projection(), angle_between(), circumference(), eccentricity(), foci(), major(), minor() (an ellipse's minor radius; for a matrix the sym_det() minor), focus_distance(), encloses_point(), focal_length(), vertex(), p_parameter(), axis_of_symmetry(), translate() and geo_length() (SymPy's length). are_similar() tests similarity.

Usage

Point3D(...)

Line3D(p, q = NULL, direction_ratio = NULL)

Segment3D(p, q)

Ray(p, q)

Ray2D(p, q)

Ray3D(p, q)

direction_ratio(e)

direction_cosine(e)

arbitrary_point(e, t = Symbol("t"))

Plane(p1, p2 = NULL, p3 = NULL, normal_vector = NULL)

normal_vector(e)

equation(e, x = Symbol("x"), y = Symbol("y"), z = Symbol("z"))

projection(e, pt, scalar = FALSE)

angle_between(e1, e2)

Ellipse(center, hradius, vradius)

major(e)

focus_distance(e)

eccentricity(e)

foci(e)

circumference(e)

encloses_point(e, pt)

Parabola(focus, directrix)

focal_length(e)

p_parameter(e)

vertex(e)

axis_of_symmetry(e)

Curve(functions, limits)

translate(e, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0)

geo_length(e)

are_similar(e1, e2)

Arguments

...

Coordinates, or points.

p, q

Points.

direction_ratio

A direction instead of the second point.

e, e1, e2

Geometric entities.

t

A parameter symbol.

p1, p2, p3

Points of a plane.

normal_vector

The normal of a plane.

x, y, z

Symbols for equations, or offsets for translate().

pt

A point, or for projection() of a CoordSys3D() vector the vector to project (Vector.projection).

scalar

Return the scalar projection factor instead.

center, hradius, vradius

Ellipse data.

focus, directrix

Parabola data (an axis parallel directrix).

functions, limits

Curve coordinates and list(t, a, b).

Value

An entity, an expression, a list or a logical.

Examples

P <- Point3D(1, 2, 3); Q <- Point3D(4, 6, 8)
L <- Line3D(P, Q)
direction_ratio(L)
#> [[1]]
#> 3
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> 4
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> 5
#> 
distance(L, Point3D(0, 0, 0))
#> 2*sqrt(3)/5
pl <- Plane(Point3D(0, 0, 0), normal_vector = c(1, 1, 1))
intersection(pl, Line3D(Point3D(0, 0, 5), Point3D(1, 1, 5)))
#> [[1]]
#> Point3D(-5/2, -5/2, 5) 
#> 
E <- Ellipse(Point(0, 0), 3, 2)
foci(E)
#> [[1]]
#> Point2D(-sqrt(5), 0) 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> Point2D(sqrt(5), 0) 
#>
